rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT method applied to interface thermodynamics; formulas for adhesion work and interfacial energy are textbook, but correct implementation requires domain knowledge of slab models, convergence tests, and handling multiple interface configurations. Not a novel algorithm, but non-trivial.
rationale.execution: Pipeline has four distinct stages (bulk optimization, surface convergence, interface construction, relaxation/energetics) with data dependencies. Requires installing Quantum ESPRESSO, generating input files, running sequential calculations, and post-processing outputs. Multi-stage orchestration but without heavy data acquisition.
